versions.versionTitle: Mishnah Torah, Yod ha-hazakah, trans. by Simon Glazer, 1927
versions.text: It is mandatory to appoint school teachers for small children in each and every state, in each and every province, and in each and every city. Any city wherein there are no children flocking to a master's house, the inhabitants thereof should be excommunicated until they do appoint teachers for the school children, if they then make no such appointment an excommunication should be pronounced against the city itself; for the world cannot endure save only by the fervent recitation of school children in the house of their master.1Baba Batra, 21b; Shabbat, 119a. C. Maimonides considers excommunication equivalent to destruction. G.
